rationale: The assistant correctly reassured that water-cooled condensing during drying is normal, hedged with 'very likely', and gave sensible leak checks (puddles, clothes dry, water left in drum). It gave estimated water use and cost figures that are generic, unsourced and fairly broad, and it offered a meter test and an inlet-valve hint that were unnecessary. It also asked for make and model at the end rather than earlier. No parts were recommended and no unsafe advice was given, so a homeowner would be well served.
critical_note: The meter check is about leaks while idle, which was fine to suggest, though the customer later refused to read the meter.
